# glinet_goodcloud (Resource)

Manage the local GoodCloud switch on GL.iNet Flint 2 (GL-MT6000). The resource calls the stock `cloud.set_config` operation, which stops the `rtty` service and may stop the `mptun` and `mpifd` services, may set `mptun.global.enable=0`, and may add a default `server` when none is configured. It does not bind or unbind the router in a GL.iNet account. Destroy releases provider ownership and leaves the current switch value unchanged.

## Import existing configuration

Use an initialized project from [Check the router](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/glinet/latest/docs#check-the-router). Add this import block with your resource address and the existing object’s ID.

```terraform
import {
  to = glinet_goodcloud.remote_management
  id = "goodcloud"
}
```

1. Add the example’s resource block with the values already on the router.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan`. For one import, expect `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`. If the plan proposes changes, match the differing arguments to the router and save a new plan.
3. Run `terraform apply adopt.tfplan` once the saved plan contains only the import. The next `terraform plan` should report `No changes`.

If you are unsure what values to use, [generate a draft from the existing object](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import/generating-configuration). Keep the import block, omit the resource block, and run `terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf`. Review the draft before preparing the saved import plan.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "glinet_goodcloud" "remote_management" {
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the stock GoodCloud agent is allowed to start. `false` calls `cloud.set_config` with `cloud_enable=false`, which also stops the stock `rtty` service, may stop `mptun` and `mpifd`, removes the local `bindtime`, may set `mptun.global.enable=0`, and may add a default `server` when none is configured. `true` starts the stock agent; a router without an account binding or server may not start a process, and Read reports that state as a warning. This resource does not change the GL.iNet account binding.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identifier. Always `goodcloud`.
